nesnd_jp_consumer_goods_reason.zh: 食品、家具和日用器皿的生意，正在从少数富户扩展到更多家庭。经营这些工场的人开始关心普通人的收入：顾客若只能勉强糊口，工场便难以扩大销路，产品的价格与收益也会受到压制。
nesnd_jp_consumer_goods_reason.en: Food, furniture and household goods are finding customers beyond the wealthiest homes. Their manufacturers have acquired a reason to care about ordinary incomes. Families struggling to feed themselves have little to spend on other goods, limiting sales and putting pressure on prices and profits.
nesnd_jp_consumer_goods_reason.source: market-model-native-review.md; current GAME concepts and state_goods script_docs
nesnd_jp_consumer_goods_reason.reason: Shared market supply, local actual prices, and tariff authority must remain distinct; no goods stockpile fiction.

nesnd_jp_open_ports_reason.zh: 日本的海外买卖长久受制于少数口岸和严密的禁令。商人希望取得远方的原料，也希望把本国出产卖到更广阔的市场。政府须重新安排开港，并处理依靠旧日禁令维持权势者的反对。
nesnd_jp_open_ports_reason.en: Japan’s overseas trade has long been confined to a few designated ports by strict prohibitions. Merchants seek distant raw materials and wider markets for their produce. The government must arrange the opening of the ports and confront those whose influence rests on the old restrictions.

nesnd_jp_mercantile_ports_junior_desc.en: Replace seclusion with mercantilism and permit overseas commerce. The common market’s tariffs remain under the control of its leading country.
